Focuses on identifying extreme funding rates to bet against the trend (contrarian).
Initial Control Strategy
Calculates the true cost of the trade by incorporating `slippage` and `spread` into the Expected Value calculation.
Adjusts the importance of Order Book Imbalance (OBI) vs. Aggressive Flow (Delta) based on the detected volatility regime.
Uses `sleep` to observe whether Polymarket odds are moving in the direction of the exchange signal before committing.
